mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attraction_info (destination_id, closed_days, opening_hours, admission_fee, parking_available, contact_number, homepage_url, guide) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{closedDays}, #{openingHours}, #{admissionFee}, #{parkingAvailable}, #{contactNumber}, #{homepageUrl}, #{guide})
mapper.select: SELECT id, destination_id, language_code, closed_days, opening_hours, admission_fee, guide FROM attraction_info_translations WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId} ORDER BY language_code ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attraction_info_translations (destination_id, language_code, closed_days, opening_hours, admission_fee, guide) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{languageCode}, #{closedDays}, #{openingHours}, #{admissionFee}, #{guide})
mapper.update: UPDATE attraction_info SET closed_days = #{closedDays}, opening_hours = #{openingHours}, admission_fee = #{admissionFee}, parking_available = #{parkingAvailable}, contact_number = #{contactNumber}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, guide = #{guide} WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId}
